_meta.purpose: Literature placement of real water-harvesting adsorbents in the 11-parameter design space (design v2) for a referee figure/table.

conventions.heat_sign: Literature isosteric heats are reported as positive magnitudes; our dH_ads is negative (exothermic), so dH_ads = -Qst.
conventions.henry_fraction_estimate: uptake just below the step / uptake at p/p0 ~ 0.9 (or the stated maximum); an estimate, not a fitted parameter.
conventions.step_definitions_differ: Sources define the step differently: 'inflection point', 'alpha' (p/p0 at half of total capacity), or the midpoint of the steep rise read from a figure. Values are recorded as given and labelled.
conventions.read_from_figure: Values labelled 'read from figure' were read by eye from rendered figures of the open-access PDFs; uncertainty roughly +/-0.01-0.02 in p/p0 and +/-10-20 cm3 STP/g in uptake.
conventions.not_sourced: cooperativity_n, particle_diameter, particle_density and bed_porosity are not intrinsic material properties of these MOFs and were not searched for; they depend on the shaped body/bed.

not_found_or_not_read: Cadiau et al. Adv. Mater. 2015 (10.1002/adma.201502418) and Permyakova et al. ChemSusChem 2017 (10.1002/cssc.201700164), the original MIL-160 papers, are paywalled (Unpaywall/Semantic Scholar: closed) and were not read. MIL-160 values come from later open-access primary measurements plus one secondary statement (Lenzen 2019).
Reinsch et al. Chem. Mater. 2013 (10.1021/cm3025445), the original CAU-10-H isotherm, was not read (the repository copy listed by Unpaywall shows 'No access').

Frohlich, Henninger, Janiak Dalton Trans. 2014 (10.1039/c4dt02264e) and Jeremias et al. RSC Adv. 2014 (10.1039/c4ra03794d) are open access at RSC, but pubs.rsc.org returned HTTP 403 to automated fetches; not read.
Laurenz et al. Energies 2020: only the abstract was read (mdpi.com returned 403); its saturation uptake and below-step uptake were not extracted.
Isosteric heat of Al-fumarate powder in Hanikel 2019 is given only as a joint 50-54 kJ/mol range for three materials.
No source gives an explicit numeric 'uptake just below the step' for MOF-303, MOF-801-P or Al-fumarate; those values are figure readings (low confidence).
